exposure: second trimester uterine artery Doppler (UAD) parameters
cohort: A subgroup of 3739 nulliparous US participants, without baseline hypertension and with complete follow-up visits 2-7 years after delivery, were analyzed from a larger cohort recruited early in pregnancy.
finding: Higher resistance and pulsatility indices measured on second trimester uterine artery Doppler were associated with significantly increased odds of incident maternal hypertension 2-7 years after delivery, while the presence of an early diastolic notch was not.
